title: Pete and the Leaf Letter
synopsis: A garden snail carries a little picture-letter past a pebble hill and grass forest to invite Kate to watch the evening sky.

related_resources.reason: Caregiver guidance encourages following curiosity and pretend play; not empirical evidence for this particular narrative.

rationale_citations.story_anchor:
The journey began with a hill.

It was a pebble.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: A scale-based visual joke repeats as the snail crosses three small obstacles.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: CDC supports following a child’s interests and pretend play as caregiver activities, not a tested effect of the pebble/forest/lake device.

source_note: Original fictional story. Parent-facing references provide context for age-appropriate playful interaction, not direct evidence about this plot or any measured developmental outcome.
